headlines.title: Trump says ‘we’re looking at’ firing Kimberly Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece
headlines.description: A Trump donor alleged Guilfoyle tried to get him to pay $100,000 to get rid of her credit card debt shortly before her confirmation hearing.

headlines.title: Florida Republican running for re-election snags presidential endorsement — from Colombia
headlines.description: Rep. María Elvira Salazar has received political support from right-wing stalwarts overseas as she finds herself on the outs with President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Rep. Omar Reacts to Feds' Home Search: I Will Not Be Silenced'
headlines.description: Rep. Ilhan Omar is responding after federal agents searched her home in Washington, D.C., on Monday morning, posting on social media “Make no mistake, this is an attempt to target political enemies.” The Justice Department is calling it part of an ongoing criminal probe, but Omar’s supporters accuse the Trump administration of a blatant abuse of power, less than three weeks before the midterm elections. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Campaigns in Ohio as Democrats Look to Flip Seat
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is continuing his campaign tour of midterm states, as Democrats make a major push to flip traditionally republican states. Meanwhile, early voting starts in Georgia Tuesday, one of the most important states on the senate map. Iowa, Kansas and North Carolina also kick off their early voting this week. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports and chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins TODAY with a deep dive on the numbers.

headlines.title: ICE officers hit man running from them with SUV
headlines.description: Family members of a man hit by a vehicle while running from iCE are demanding justice. The man has a broken leg after being struck. DHS says the man ran in front of the vehicle but video of the incident appears to show the SUV veering into him. NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.
